messages:
nina: Brief - we need a clear, customer-friendly flow for "RCA on request" after postmortems. Two minutes per reply pls.
sam: Goal: public summary + guaranteed RCA timeframe + simple request path. Also decide what parts of the internal RCA we redact by default.
maria: Legal: default public summary + commit to publish a public RCA in 7 business days. Full internal RCA can be shared upon request; require signed data-sharing addendum for logs or PII. We'll provide redacted internal RCA without logs by default.
raj: Ops concerns: customers might want timelines for remediation steps. We can include a high-level remediation timeline in the public summary and put detailed timelines in the full RCA. Also add verification steps.
oliver: For outreach, top-tier customers should get a personalized offer for a walkthrough call and expedited request handling. Others use the public summary + support request option.
support-bot: Support flow: customer emails support@ -> auto-ticket -> tag "incident-rca" -> PSA triages -> comms/legal notified. Add SLA: acknowledge request in 2 business days.
nina: Can we standardize an email template for support so PSA knows what to ask? e.g., level of detail required, NDAs, example use-cases.
maria: Yes, I'll add a short intake template: purpose of request, desired artifacts (summary vs logs), contact + legal contact. That will speed up addendum routing.
raj: Also recommend we pre-generate a "redacted internal RCA" version that excludes raw traces and IPs; that can be shared faster. Full logs only with addendum.
sam: Good. Let's set the public-facing language: simple wording, non-technical, timeline commitment, and the request path. Keep it consistent across status page and account outreach.
oliver: I'll build two outreach templates (top-tier + broadcast) that reference the public summary and include the CTA to request full RCA.
support-bot: Action items staged: 1) Draft public summary template - elaine? or nina volunteer? 2) Intake template for support - maria. 3) Redacted-internal RCA template - raj. 4) Outreach templates - oliver. 5) SLA for requests and acknowledgment - support-bot to enforce.
nina: I will draft the public summary template today and post to #incidents-drafts. ETA EOD.
maria: Intake template + addendum instructions - I will post legal-approved text by tomorrow EOB.
raj: I'll draft the redaction checklist and the redacted-RCA format. Spike complete by next Tue.
oliver: Outreach templates ready by Fri AM once public summary exists.
sam: Ok owners noted. After drafts are up, we'll do one quick review pass and publish the templates as part of the postmortem checklist. Close this thread when templates are in staging.
support-bot: Reminders set for owners: nina (status draft), maria (intake), raj (redaction), oliver (outreach). Acknowledgement SLA configured: 2 business days.
